description: One-time setup, not part of publishing: registers this MCP server and installs the Gamealia skills/rules in coding agents (claude-code, claude-desktop, codex, gemini, cursor, vscode, windsurf, cline, zed, opencode, kimi, agents-md). Dry run by default (write:true applies); returns the planned file changes plus copy-paste snippets (claude mcp add, Codex TOML, Cursor/VS Code install links). Project scope writes agent config files into dir (.mcp.json, .claude/skills, .cursor/, .vscode/, .codex/, AGENTS.md/GEMINI.md blocks, ...); global scope edits the user's own agent configs (~/.claude.json, ~/.codex/config.toml, Claude Desktop, ...). Merges idempotently, backs up every changed file first and leaves unparsable files alone; `gamealia agents uninstall` reverts it.

dir.description: Project folder for project scope (default: the server's working directory)

scope.description: project (default): config files inside dir; without targets sets up Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code plus the agents detected. global: the user's own agent configs; without targets only the detected agents

serverPath.description: Path of the gamealia-mcp.mjs the agents should run (default: this running server's bundle)

targets.description: Agents to set up, e.g. ["claude-code", "cursor"] (default: depends on scope, see scope)

write.description: Apply the changes (default false: dry run, nothing is written)

name: gamealia_install_agent_kit
title: Register Gamealia in coding agents
